text:
zara: deploy-bot auto-picked a minor for PR#4722 (internal refactor of retry logic). I think patch is fine. Any objections?

deploy-bot: heuristic summary: changed files under src/retry/* and tests -> default: minor. Rule: any src/ change defaults to minor unless PR title contains [PATCH] or author uses CLI override.

mike: That heuristic is noisy. Retry logic refactor didn't change API or public behavior. Patch + short changelog note.

anya: Agreed. We keep minors for user-facing additions or breaking changes. Internal refactors should be patch.

zara: Quick workaround: retitling to include [PATCH] and running `./tools/releasebot release --patch-only`. Will do that now.

release-bot: note: manual override accepted. Also recommending: add `semver: patch` in PR body frontmatter to help changelog generator.

mike: Long-term: can we change deploy-bot to check for exported symbols changes? e.g., diff of `pub` surface or routes -> only then minor. Non-export changes -> patch.

anya: Also propose a "stable-window preference" flag: during code-freeze windows the default should bias to patch unless explicitly marked minor. Prevents accidental churn.

zara: Filed a tiny RFC in releng: /rfc/semver-refinements-2026.md. Added examples.

mike: One more ops note: when forcing a patch, ensure the release-notes pipeline puts the entry under Bugfixes not Features. We've seen forced patches land in the wrong bucket. Use frontmatter `section: Bugfixes` when forcing.

deploy-bot: enhancement logged: add exported-symbols check + stable-window bias. Will also add a one-line rationale to tag messages: "reason: src change -> default minor".

zara: Retitled PR -> now [PATCH] and adding `semver: patch` in body. Kicking off `--patch-only` job.

release-bot: tag applied: v5.6.3 (patch) by @zara. Tag message includes: "reason: author override; changed internal retry logic; no public API changes".

anya: Thanks. Filing follow-up to update playbook with examples of when to mark [MINOR] vs [PATCH].

mike: Tiny improvement request: when deploy-bot suggests minor, annotate the PR with a short checklist: "Public API changed? Docs changed? Exports changed?" so reviewers can decide quickly.

release-bot: queued. Will add checklist and a link to the RFC in the annotation.

zara: Closing thread. Patch applied; release-notes updated. :white_check_mark:
